brief:
Amnesty International has called on the international community to impose sanctions on Israeli officials implicated in violations of international law, the Palestine News Network reported. The rights group also urged urgent action to halt escalating attacks by settlers against Palestinians in the West Bank.

The organization's statement comes as settler violence in the occupied territory continues to intensify, affecting Palestinian communities and property across the region.
dek: WASHINGTON / PNN/ Amnesty International has called on the international community to impose sanctions on Israeli officials implicated in violations of international law and to take urgent action to halt the escalating attacks by settlers against Palestinians…
title: Amnesty International demands sanctions on Israeli officials over West Bank violations
